recognize_zh: 低倍骨髓切片（上下兩格）中，骨小樑之間的骨髓腔除了脂肪細胞外，大片區域被淡粉紅色、無細胞的無定形物質填滿，造血細胞只剩零散小群；在低倍下就能看出這種間質沉積，提示類澱粉（amyloid）。
features: Low-power trephine with thin bony trabeculae and intertrabecular marrow spaces
Abundant pale eosinophilic, acellular, amorphous interstitial material filling spaces between adipocytes
Residual hematopoietic cells in small patches and scattered singly around the deposits
Preserved fat cells; no discrete tumor nodules at this magnification
describe_en: Low-power views of a bone marrow trephine biopsy (H&E, two fields) show thin bony trabeculae with intertrabecular marrow containing preserved adipocytes. Much of the interstitium is occupied by pale eosinophilic, acellular, amorphous material, with residual hematopoietic cells arranged in small patches and scattered singly around the deposits. No discrete nodules or sheets of tumor cells are identified at this magnification, and cytologic detail of plasma cells cannot be assessed. The pattern is suggestive of interstitial amyloid deposition, which should be confirmed by Congo red staining with apple-green birefringence and accompanied by CD138 and kappa/lambda studies.

ddx.vs: Occurs in cachexia with atrophic fat cells and pale basophilic-pink granular ground substance that is Alcian blue positive and Congo red negative.
Edema is paler and wispy and hemorrhage consists of red cells, neither forming dense amorphous waxy deposits.
Fibrosis shows streaming spindle cells and collagen demonstrated by reticulin/trichrome rather than structureless material.
